notification_setting_quiet_hours_check.name: notification_setting_quiet_hours_check
notification_setting_quiet_hours_check.value: "notification_setting"."quiet_start_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "notification_setting"."quiet_end_minute" between 0 and 1439 and "notification_setting"."quiet_start_minute" <> "notification_setting"."quiet_end_minute"

recurring_amount_check.name: recurring_amount_check
recurring_amount_check.value: "recurring_series"."baseline_amount_cents" > 0 AND "recurring_series"."baseline_amount_cents" <= 10000000000 AND ("recurring_series"."amount_cents" IS NULL OR ("recurring_series"."amount_cents" > 0 AND "recurring_series"."amount_cents" <= 10000000000))

recurring_choice_check.name: recurring_choice_check
recurring_choice_check.value: "recurring_series"."decision" IN ('candidate', 'confirmed', 'dismissed') AND "recurring_series"."kind" IN ('bill', 'subscription', 'income') AND "recurring_series"."amount_mode" IN ('fixed', 'variable') AND "recurring_series"."user_intent" IN ('none', 'keep', 'cancel')

recurring_merchant_check.name: recurring_merchant_check
recurring_merchant_check.value: char_length("recurring_series"."merchant_normalized") BETWEEN 1 AND 500 AND char_length("recurring_series"."name") BETWEEN 1 AND 80

bill_cycle_values_check.name: bill_cycle_values_check
bill_cycle_values_check.value: "bill_cycle"."revision" > 0 AND "bill_cycle"."date_source" IN ('user', 'predicted') AND "bill_cycle"."estimate_cents" >= 0 AND "bill_cycle"."estimate_cents" <= 10000000000 AND ("bill_cycle"."invoice_cents" IS NULL OR ("bill_cycle"."invoice_cents" >= 0 AND "bill_cycle"."invoice_cents" <= 10000000000))

bill_payment_values_check.name: bill_payment_values_check
bill_payment_values_check.value: "bill_payment"."amount_cents" > 0 AND "bill_payment"."amount_cents" <= 10000000000 AND (("bill_payment"."evidence_workspace_id" IS NULL AND "bill_payment"."transaction_id" IS NULL) OR ("bill_payment"."evidence_workspace_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bill_payment"."transaction_id" IS NOT NULL AND "bill_payment"."evidence_workspace_id" = "bill_payment"."workspace_id" AND "bill_payment"."transaction_id" = "bill_payment"."original_transaction_id"))
